nodes.label: Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) Graph Index
nodes.description: Multi-layer graph-based proximity search structure organizing high-dimensional embeddings into hierarchical skip-list layers for logarithmic time approximate nearest neighbor retrieval.

nodes.label: Product Quantization (PQ) Vector Compression
nodes.description: Lossy vector compression algorithm decomposing high-dimensional vector spaces into Cartesian products of lower-dimensional subspaces and quantizing vectors to centroid codebooks.

nodes.label: OWL 2 Web Ontology Language Direct Semantics Reasoner
nodes.description: Description logic tableau reasoning engine evaluating TBox subsumption, ABox consistency, and class satisfiability per W3C OWL 2 Direct Semantics specification.

nodes.label: Counting Bloom Filter Candidate Edge Pruner
nodes.description: Probabilistic space-efficient spatial filter eliminating non-existent edge candidate lookup queries prior to expensive physical disk index traversal.

nodes.label: Khoja Triliteral Arabic Root Extraction Engine
nodes.description: Morphological stemming algorithm designed to strip prefixes, suffixes, and inflected markers to reduce complex Arabic entity surface forms to canonical root lemmas.
